title: Total derived limit of simultaneous reduction is integral derived completion
statement: For a prime ell, any scheme W and the derived-category universe choices in [def-sfb-diagonal-system-interface], every simultaneous derived reduction D of the integral-to-discrete-Z_ell scalar extension satisfies DiagonalCompletionSpec. Thus an integral simultaneous reduction I and total right derived limits RF and RZ exist, D.T followed by RF and scalar forgetting is naturally isomorphic to I.T followed by RZ, this common functor has ell-complete outputs in the right-orthogonality sense, and a natural unit induces a bijection on maps to every such complete object.

source.place: Proof step 4: scalar restriction, total derived strict inverse limits, and the integral completion reflector

proof.text: Use the exact Z-to-Z_ell scalar extension and its levelwise right adjoint. Construct both total right derived limits from K-injective resolutions. The right adjoint preserves K-injectives because scalar extension is exact; its ordinary limit comparison gives the derived-limit comparison.

Every integral quotient is killed by ell^(n+1), so equip its actual sections with the canonical ZMod action and restrict the p-adic action through toZModPow. Any additive map out of an ell-power killed p-adic module is p-adic linear, by the approximation congruence. The scalar adjunction therefore identifies the two quotient universal properties. Cokernel uniqueness supplies a natural isomorphism of the whole ordinary towers; cancel quotient epimorphisms to prove every transition square and naturality. Derive this comparison: the exact tower restriction has a derived right adjoint, so it preserves the pointwise right Kan extension defining the left derived functor. Uniqueness of left derived functors gives the derived tower isomorphism.

Apply the integral strict completion reflector to the integral reduction and total derived limit. Whisker and compose the two preceding isomorphisms, transport its natural unit, transfer output orthogonality using the induced injective Hom equivalence, and compose the universal Hom bijection with the induced source Hom equivalence.

proof_origin.place: Explicit ordinary torsion quotient comparison, preservation of pointwise derived Kan extension by the exact derived right adjoint, total derived limit comparison, and transport of the integral reflector

lean.statement:
theorem diagonal_reduction_completion (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (W : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalAb W)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalMod ℓ W)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalSystems ℓ W)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DiagonalAb W)]
    (D : DiagonalDerivedReduction ℓ (diagonalScalarExtension ℓ W)) :
    DiagonalCompletionSpec ℓ W D
